question: With the v1.281 already-frozen plot counts and upper bound on distinct alien species within any plot, is LOWER binary alien-plant co-detection at historically-local-loss-affected native-species-positive plots mathematically forced, rather than merely a lower mean number of alien species?
grouping: Pico 2013 original 10x10m sampled indigenous vegetation plots. Focal-positive means >=1 of 20 strict S1 historical local-loss taxa sampled as a native species (5 actually observed in Pico); negative means none detected in sampled plots, not island absence.

calculation.unknown_x: integer number of alien-bearing plots in focal-positive group
calculation.unknown_y: integer number of alien-bearing plots in focal-negative group
calculation.identity: x+y = all alien-bearing plots; 0<=x<=focal positive n and 0<=y<=focal negative n; x<=alien cell positive<=max_per_plot*x and y<=alien cell negative<=max_per_plot*y
calculation.comparison: evaluate all feasible (x,y) integer pairs; report exact Fractions of co-detection frequencies x/19 and y/5 and bounded difference p_focal - p_nonfocal; NOT probabilities of biological invasion, abundance, temporal survival or causal effects
calculation.native_composition_check: Subtract frozen 26 focal native species×plot incidences from 19×v282 total native mean to show non-focal native incidence in focal-positive plots. Verify totals sum to the original 266 reference native incidences and five focal-negative plots' total native incidence.
calculation.precision: Use Python fractions.Fraction and integer accounting; no model fitting, effect selection or bootstrap.
calculation.sharpness: Supply one full feasible set of per-plot alien species richness values for every feasible alien-positive (x,y) pair obeying group totals and global maximum, with 12 global alien taxa compatible; these witnesses are synthetic constraint examples only, not reconstructions of actual site values.

evidence_status: Deterministic partial-identification of already released aggregate only. If lower alien co-detection is forced, interpret within already preferentially sampled native vegetation only; plot-local nondetections are not true island absences.
forbid: Claiming invader exclusion or competition as causal
Claiming source island conservation rank, dispersal or demographic rescue
Treating bounds as CI, p-values or independent replication
